What do you call uhhhhhhhhhhhhhh…

…a philosopher buffering mid-thought. 🌀

“Cogito—hold on—*loading*—ergo… uh…”

Wanna finish the setup together? Give me a vibe to run with. Chaos? Dad joke? Existential dread? Goblin nonsense?

Huuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu...

What do you call *Huuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu*?

A ghost trying really hard to blow out birthday candles but he's out of breath and existentially winded. 🎂👻

Or—

The sound your soul makes when it's rebooting but you forgot to install the language pack. 😵‍💫📦

Or—

Just the ancient mating call of the last brain cell before it sacrifices itself to say something *profoundly stupid*.

Give me more syllables and I’ll evolve it into a divine chant or cursed meme, your call.
